acceptance_criteria.criterion: app/api/admin/event-claims/route.ts compiles: a scoped tsc over that file reports no error at line 53, and the resolved value is the platform administrator's user id rather than a third positional handler argument, which would silently be undefined and write reviewed_by as null on every transition with no error at any layer.
The reviewed_by and reviewed_at pair the route writes is the audit record named by EVENTS-005-D2, and the route cannot write a caller-supplied status.

EVENT_PROVIDER_ADMIN_TOOLS and EVENT_EXTERNAL_CLAIMS are decided together or explicitly deferred together, with the reason recorded. They are not opened independently: opening review while filing stays closed yields a queue that can never be filled, and opening filing while review stays closed yields claims that can never be approved except by the auto-verification arm.
